sections.title: dbd emit
body: dbd emit translates the schema into another engine’s DDL, MySQL, T-SQL or SQLite, and reports what each target cannot take, including types beyond its limits. You find out before you migrate, not during.

code.text: dbd emit   # MySQL, T-SQL or SQLite, with a list of what does not fit

sections.caption: One schema becomes three dialects, with a won't-fit report.

sections.title: DBML and an interactive diagram
body: dbd dbml generates DBML documentation from the design, and dbd diagram opens the schema in a hosted interactive viewer. dbd graph outputs the dependency graph as JSON for your own tools.
sections.caption: Docs and a diagram drawn straight from the source.

sections.title: What schema as code buys you
body: Reviewed changes, drift checks, generated migrations, seed data in the repo, and documentation that cannot go stale. That is the case for dbd.
sections.caption: One source schema fans out to three engines.
